styleLock.direction: clean airy base-makeup ecommerce with a shade-matching spine
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF packshot field alternating with an airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 daylight field and a creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 swatch surface; flat graphic panels use a white #FFFFFF card inside the sky-blue frame
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright cool-neutral high-key studio light, large soft front key with fill card, sweeping highlight along glass edges, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 swatch surface and seamless white #FFFFFF paper; overhead graphic panels sit on a matte white card
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short headline lines plus thin label rows, all copy carried by placeholders in charcoal #33383D or white #FFFFFF
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line tick marks and rounded numbered step markers in white #FFFFFF on a deep plum #6B2E70 ribbon
styleLock.presentationRules: bottle stays upright at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on scale across packshot and scene shots; swatch ribbons are always single sweeping strokes with a tapered tail
noDrift: no shade numbers or colour names rendered on image
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean airy base-makeup visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, airy sky-blue #A9CBE4, creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 and one deep plum accent #6B2E70; bright cool-neutral high-key studio lighting with a large soft front key, fill card, sweeping highlights along glass edges and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with short headline lines; thin-line tick icons and rounded numbered step markers on a deep plum ribbon; flat graphic panels use a white card inside a sky-blue frame; stable upright slight 3/4 product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用白底合规构图讲清泵头瓶型与一抹奶油质地
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle upright, full product visible and not cropped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large soft front key with fill card, soft contact shadow
shots.props: one sweeping cream swatch ribbon laid diagonally behind the bottle
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle stands upright at a straight-on eye-level view with the full product visible and nothing cropped by the frame edge. Bright even high-key studio lighting from a large soft front key with a fill card, soft contact shadow grounding the base. One single sweeping cream swatch ribbon runs diagonally behind the bottle across a seamless white #FFFFFF field. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 4K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no readable label words or brand marks, no hands, no props beyond the single swatch ribbon, no text, no watermark, no tinted or gradient background, no hard shadow, no floating product.

shots.intent: 主图一秒法则，用斜角仰拍与三条勾选行承接核心妆效主张
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle looking upward, product tilted on a diagonal
shots.lighting: bright cool-neutral daylight, sweeping highlight along the glass edge, soft shadow
shots.background: airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 with faint cloud haze
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 55% for copy
shots.textZone: left third holds three stacked short claim lines with thin tick positions
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pump bottle is photographed from a very low angle looking upward and tilted on a diagonal so the pump head reads clearly at the top of the frame. Bright cool-neutral daylight with a sweeping highlight along the glass edge and a soft shadow behind the shoulder. Background airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 with faint cloud haze. Three stacked short claim lines in white #FFFFFF with thin-line tick positions run down the left third, reading 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space on the left 55% reserved for copy. Negative: no more than three claim lines, no invented efficacy wording, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra props, no duplicated bottle.

shots.intent: 放大选错底妆色调的日常顾虑，用清单式对照行给出判定入口
shots.camera: flat frontal graphic panel, product inset at a slight 3/4 angle in the upper corner
shots.lighting: even high-key flat light, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: seamless white #FFFFFF card inside an airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 frame
shots.props: three rounded undertone chips and one circular numbered step marker
shots.whitespace: structured white margins between the rows
shots.textZone: top headline band plus three paired row-label and chip slots
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point infographic panel about choosing the wrong base tone. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three stacked checklist rows of short generic self-check lines sit on a white card, each row paired with one rounded undertone chip, and {product} appears small at a slight 3/4 angle in the upper inset so the problem and the product share one frame. Flat frontal graphic panel photographed straight-on at eye level; a deep plum #6B2E70 ribbon with a circular numbered step marker runs above the rows. Background seamless white #FFFFFF inside an airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 frame, even high-key flat light. Headline reads 「{callout_1}」 in charcoal #33383D and the chip labels read 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame with structured white margins between rows. Negative: no skin-condition diagnosis, no invented test data or statistics, no more than three rows, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no real person.

shots.intent: 让买家代入真实上脸妆效，建立光泽与肤感的预期
shots.camera: close 3/4 portrait framing at eye level, head and shoulders only
shots.lighting: bright soft front key with a large fill, gentle catchlight, no harsh speculars
shots.whitespace: clean margin beside the headline line
shots.textZone: left upper quarter for one short benefit line
shots.promptTemplate: Beauty wear shot for the base look created by {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A generic adult model with no resemblance to any real or public person is framed head-and-shoulders at eye level in a close 3/4 portrait, hair sweeping across one side, natural skin texture with visible pores and an even finish. Bright soft front key with a large fill and a gentle catchlight in the eyes. Background airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 seamless paper. One short benefit line 「{selling_point_1}」 sits in the left upper quarter in charcoal #33383D. The face and shoulders occupy 40-50% of the frame with clean margin beside the headline. Negative: no celebrity likeness, no plastic over-smoothed airbrushed skin, no visible brand packaging in frame, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no props.

shots.intent: 三只手臂同框同光比色，消除深浅与色调是否合肤的疑虑
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, three matched panels in one frame
shots.lighting: even high-key soft overhead light, skimming highlight across the film, soft skin-contact shadows
shots.props: three forearms with relaxed hands, short neutral nails, no jewellery
shots.whitespace: even gutters between the three arms
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce swatch comparison of the formula from {product}: three matched forearms arranged side by side with identical framing and identical lighting, photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each inner wrist carries one short blended swatch band at a different skin depth so the eye compares match rather than names. Even high-key soft overhead light with a skimming highlight revealing the creamy film and soft skin-contact shadows on a matte creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 surface. Relaxed hands with short neutral nails, no jewellery. Arms and product content occupy 35-40% of the frame with even gutters and no extra whitespace. Negative: no faces, no hands covering the swatches, no text or colour names, no invented shade claims, no deformed or fused fingers, no watermark, no fake logo, no harsh shadows.

shots.intent: 用质地微距证明延展性与成膜后的奶油般平滑感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the swatch surface, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the upper left revealing emulsion texture, soft shadow under the thicker edge
shots.whitespace: clean white margin at the lower right
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the cream formula swept from {product}, tight zoom on the ribbon body and its tapered tail. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the leading edge sharp and the tail softening away. Skimming side light from the upper left reveals the smooth emulsion surface and the fine ridge along the fold, with a soft shadow under the thicker edge. Background seamless white #FFFFFF. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with a clean white margin at the lower right. 4K macro beauty texture quality. Negative: no cracked or cakey texture, no plastic-looking product, no separated oily edges, no text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props, no blurry subject.

shots.intent: 用四条叠压色带展示可选深浅跨度与一致的质地表现
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down across the layered bands, tight zoom
shots.lighting: sweeping soft light from the right gliding along each ridge, gentle specular on the wetter edge
shots.background: creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 base under the bands
shots.whitespace: minimal, the stacked bands are the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up detail shot of four layered ribbons of the cream formula from {product}, arranged as stacked horizontal arcs stepping from the lightest to the deepest tone. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down across the bands in a tight zoom so the arcs run the full width of the frame. Sweeping soft light from the right glides along each ridge, a gentle specular sheen sits on the wetter edge and a soft shadow falls where each band overlaps the next, over a creamy nude-beige #EBD6C0 base. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace. Negative: no colour names or numbers, no muddy blended tones between bands, no duplicated band shapes, no text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 一屏看全色阶跨度，让买家自行挑色缩短决策
shots.camera: flat lay from directly above, rectangular panels in a three-row grid on a white field
shots.lighting: even high-key flat studio light, identical exposure across all panels
shots.background: seamless white #FFFFFF gutters and margin around the grid
shots.props: one upright {product} bottle overlapping the lower-left corner of the grid
shots.whitespace: generous white margin framing the grid
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant shade wall for {product}: a grid of rectangular swatch panels of the same cream formula, separated by crisp white gutters, laid flat and photographed from directly above, with one upright bottle overlapping the lower-left corner as the anchor. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Panels step in an even gradient from the lightest to the deepest tone, each keeping the same soft sheen and tapered tail so the family reads as one formula range. Even high-key flat studio light with identical exposure across every panel, seamless white #FFFFFF gutters and margin framing the grid. The grid plus the bottle occupy 35-40% of the frame. Negative: no shade numbers, no colour names or any on-image text, no duplicated or repeated panels, no lighting drift between panels, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 以行列对照表收口选色决策，降低买错色的顾虑并促成下单
shots.camera: flat frontal graphic panel photographed straight-on, product upright at a slight 3/4 angle in the lower-left corner
shots.lighting: even high-key flat light with a soft contact shadow under the bottle
shots.background: airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 field framing a white #FFFFFF card
shots.props: grid of small swatch smears with empty header slots and one deep plum ribbon
shots.whitespace: clean white margins around the matrix card
shots.textZone: top header band plus empty row and column header slots
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust infographic: a shade-matching matrix for {product} laid out as rows and columns of small formula smears on a white card, photographed straight-on as a flat frontal panel. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The {product} bottle stands upright at a slight 3/4 angle in the lower-left corner as the scale anchor. Empty row and column header slots in charcoal #33383D carry only the placeholders 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, and a deep plum #6B2E70 ribbon marks the step line above the matrix. Background airy sky-blue #A9CBE4 framing the white #FFFFFF card, even high-key flat light with a soft contact shadow under the bottle. The product and matrix together occupy 35-40% of the frame with clean white margins for copy. Negative: no shade numbers or colour names rendered, no invented certifications ratings or test data, no dense body text, no tiny unreadable labels, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底泵头瓶直立、身后斜拉一抹奶油色带；002 白底单条色痕特写；003 人物面部近景配左上大字主张；004 三只手臂俯拍同框、各腕一道比色痕；005 泵瓶斜角仰拍置于晴空底、左侧三条勾选主张；006 17 格色号矩形墙；007 四条色带上下叠压满幅；008 两栏式色调自查信息图（勾选项 + 三枚色调色块）；009 深浅行 x 色调列的选色对照矩阵。品类判定依据：图为按压泵瓶装流动性肤色乳液、成套主打上脸妆效与色阶比色，属着色彩底妆而非护理，故 L1 取「美妆彩妆」/L2 取「底妆」；源链接类目仅作线索，模版按泵瓶液体粉底与库内海绵气垫类底妆模版作形态区分。已剥离内容：瓶身与图内全部字标、系列名、原文案原句、色号编号与色号名、成分与功效字样、防晒与「看起来更年轻」类主张数字、模特面容身份（改无身份 generic 模型）以及平台角标与评价类社会证明，全部改 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 空位或空白对照单元；产品一律 {product} 占位。
